mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates severe labor market deterioration that suppresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE) signals a dual demand shock that depresses corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 330000 and UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive quarterly declines in real GDP (GDPC1) indicate recessionary demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations that increase real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad supply-demand mismatch that reduces corporate output and revenue growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and HOUST < 580, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent industrial production decline (INDPRO) for two consecutive months signals a supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
